prompt:
Sophisticated adult gothic colouring-book artwork in crisp black pen-and-ink on pure white, with confident clean contours, medium interior outlines, precise ornamental linework, delicate crosshatching and sparse stippling. Create elegant theatrical stylisation, high detail in decorative textures and open colourable areas, with no grey fills, gradients or solid black masses. Maintain a cosy yet ominous candlelit storybook mood, clear focal hierarchy, refined engraving-like texture and printer-friendly line clarity.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Sophisticated monochrome pen-and-ink colouring-book illustration with a gothic storybook sensibility, designed for leisurely adult colouring.; line weight: Crisp confident outer contours with medium interior outlines and selectively fine ornamental linework.; line quality: Clean, controlled hand-inked linework; elegant curves, precise hatching and clearly separated enclosed shapes.; detail level: High adult-level detail concentrated in decorative surfaces and architectural ornament, balanced by generous open areas for comfortable colouring; no muddy micro-detail.; character language: Expressive stylised figures with graceful, theatrical silhouettes, readable gestures and refined period-inspired costume detailing rather than realistic anatomy.; background density: Layered and immersive, with ornamental background detail kept lighter and more open than the principal forms to maintain clear focal hierarchy.; composition: Strong central focal hierarchy, balanced asymmetry or formal symmetry where appropriate, clear depth layers, and deliberate breathing room around intricate motifs.; palette: Monochrome black ink on a pure white ground, with all tonal richness created through line density and optional colourer-led choices.; colour mode: black-and-white line art; shading: No grey fills, gradients or solid black shading; use sparse crosshatching, contour hatching and patterned shadow marks only where needed for depth.; texture: Fine engraved-paper feel conveyed through crosshatching, stippling accents, ornamental motifs and varied textile-inspired patterns.; mood: Cosy, elegant and ominous: candlelit seasonal warmth offset by refined supernatural unease..

PAGE 14 of "Hollowbone Manor Masquerade" (colouring): Gothic portrait gallery containing exactly seven framed portraits of different masked skeleton ancestors in period finery; one skeletal portrait figure stepping partly out of its frame, gilt mirror with an eerie candlelit reflection, ornate wallpaper and small console tables.

PAGE DETAIL: A richly ornamented gallery contains seven framed ancestor portraits. In each portrait, a different masked skeletal figure poses in period finery; one figure steps partly out of its frame while a living-looking candlelit reflection appears in a gilt mirror opposite. Notes: Exactly seven portrait frames, each clearly countable. Keep the emerging figure non-gory and make the mirror reflection decorative rather than visually confusing.

BOOK CONSISTENCY: This is page 14 of 25 in one colouring book whose style the owner approved from pages 2, 3, 25. Draw it in exactly that approved style: the same line weight and line quality, the same level of detail and colouring difficulty, the same visual density, border treatment and page margins, the same black-and-white treatment and the same character designs where characters appear. Do not restyle this page.

CANVAS: A single portrait design with a plain white background. Keep a clear margin on every side; nothing important touches the edges, so it prints cleanly on a home printer. It is a colouring page: clean closed outlines on white, no grey fills or shading, easy to colour. Each single-sided page uses a practical inner safety margin, a strong central scene and clearly enclosed colourable spaces for A4 and US Letter home printing. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Any copied characters, logos, trademarks, titles or distinctive compositions from existing Halloween media; Photorealism or realistic horror gore; Grey shading, colour, gradients or large solid-black ink areas; Muddy micro-detail, tangled lines or unclear colouring spaces; Childish cartoon styling or overly cute expressions; Modern objects or incongruous contemporary visual language; Misspelled, distorted or illegible text.
